title: Cocoa Casa- A Chocolate Themed Stay Near Downtown
description:
Not your average Nashville stay, Cocoa Casa blends comfort, style, and a touch of chocolate-inspired charm. Thoughtfully designed with eclectic decor and subtle nods to chocolate history, this space offers a stay that feels both cozy and memorable. Located just 3.3 miles from downtown, with handmade chocolate from Poppy & Peep right next door.

The space
Decorated by a creative interior designer and a chocolate sommelier, each room has a bit of chocolate history and of course chocolate that you can enjoy during your stay. Each window has blackout roller blinds and curtains so you decide the amount of light in the rooms ensuring a good nights sleep. There is a full washer and dryer in case you stay for awhile.

Guest access
Guests can access the entire apartment!

Other things to note
Free Parking

Industrial Area up on a hill

Matryoshka Coffee, Aloha Fish, Bongo Java Roasters, and Poppy & Peep Chocolate all within walking distance
